change_interpretations.engineering_summary: Adds a new requirement for positive torque derating envelope limiting and diagnostic event logging under elevated thermal load. Verification must ensure both torque derating and diagnostic logging are validated.

assessments.reason: The test measures standard driver torque response timing against unchanged requirement VCU-DR-01. It does not test thermal load or derating events.
evidence: VCU-DR-01 is unchanged
Procedure verifies pedal step response to 75% within 100 ms
assessments.recommended_action: Maintain existing test setup for driver torque response verification.

assessments.reason: The test evaluates emergency brake priority over driver torque demand under unchanged requirements VCU-DR-01 and VCU-BRK-03. It is unrelated to thermal derating.
evidence: VCU-BRK-03 and VCU-DR-01 are unchanged
Procedure inspects emergency brake command priority over 85% pedal input
assessments.recommended_action: Retain test for brake override regression testing.

assessments.reason: The requirement link is missing, and workshop notes state that high-load campaign links were lost during migration. Human review is required to confirm whether 'high-load cases' refer to thermal load under VCU-THM-07 or dynamic demand under VCU-DR-01.
evidence: Requirement link is missing
Procedure specifies demand sweep at high-load cases
Workshop note: High-load campaign did not keep all requirement hyperlinks after migration
assessments.recommended_action: Reconcile requirement link with the system engineer to determine applicability to VCU-THM-07.

assessments.reason: The test measures brake actuator command latency for emergency braking under unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03. It does not exercise thermal torque derating.
evidence: VCU-BRK-03 is unchanged
Procedure targets brake command latency within 100 ms

assessments.reason: The test verifies degraded operating mode upon wheel-speed sensor fault per unchanged requirement VCU-DGN-04. It does not cover thermal derating functions.
evidence: VCU-DGN-04 is unchanged
Procedure unplugs wheel-speed sensor to verify fault response
assessments.recommended_action: Keep test in standard regression suite.

assessments.reason: The test checks timestamped drive mode audit logging under unchanged requirement VCU-LOG-05. It does not verify thermal derating diagnostic events.
evidence: VCU-LOG-05 is unchanged
Procedure verifies mode change logging from Comfort to Sport
assessments.recommended_action: Retain test procedure for mode event logging.

assessments.reason: The test procedure evaluates pedal demand at elevated load, which directly aligns with newly added requirement VCU-THM-07. The procedure and target criteria must be updated to verify the derated torque envelope and derating diagnostic event logging.
evidence: VCU-THM-07 added requirement for thermal torque derating envelope and diagnostic event logging
Procedure tests 80% pedal at elevated load
Requirement link is currently TBD
assessments.recommended_action: Link test to VCU-THM-07 and update procedure to assert derated torque limit compliance and diagnostic event logging.

assessments.reason: The requirement link VCU-OLD-88 is unknown due to a catalog revision, leaving traceability broken. Review is needed to establish whether this legacy diagnostic trace relates to new derating diagnostic logging.
evidence: Requirement reference is unknown_requirement (VCU-OLD-88)
Comment indicates imported row from changed requirements catalog
assessments.recommended_action: Review requirement mapping with requirement owner to re-link or archive the test.

assessments.reason: The test compares Sport and Comfort driving mode torque ramp profiles per unchanged requirement VCU-MOD-06. It does not evaluate thermal torque limits.
evidence: VCU-MOD-06 is unchanged
Procedure compares accelerator response under Sport vs Comfort profiles
assessments.recommended_action: Maintain existing test procedure for mode ramp profiles.

assessments.reason: The test verifies filtering of transient pedal spikes under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-02. It does not test thermal derating.
evidence: VCU-DR-02 is unchanged
Procedure injects a 7 ms transient pedal pulse
assessments.recommended_action: Keep test in regression suite for driver input validation.

assessments.reason: The test checks positive torque cancellation upon emergency brake input under unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03. It does not involve thermal load behavior.
evidence: VCU-BRK-03 is unchanged
Procedure verifies positive torque drop on emergency braking request
assessments.recommended_action: Retain test for brake override verification.

assessments.reason: The test checks platform ECU wake-up timing following a power cycle. It does not exercise propulsion torque control or thermal load logic.
evidence: Procedure measures ECU readiness within 500 ms
Comment notes platform startup only
assessments.recommended_action: Maintain test for startup timing verification.
